whatItDoes: This hybrid podcasting microphone supplies the superb sound of the standard MV7 and updates it with new features, including a touch-sensitive LED strip, complete computer control, and compatibility with the Shure MOTIV Mix desktop app.
pros: Hybrid USB/XLR Dynamic Microphone with Onboard DSP, LED Strip, Headphone Jack, and App-based Control – Black.
Within the app, you can choose from more than 16 million LED colors and behaviors.
Plus, the app includes new tools like the Digital Popper Stopper, a real-time Denoiser, and three reverb types.
When it comes to outstanding sound and visual flexibility, the Shure MV7+ checks all the boxes.
